summary: This clinical trial studies the effects of a dietary supplement called LP-LDL® on adults with prediabetes, type 1 diabetes, or type 2 diabetes and high cholesterol or triglycerides. Researchers want to see how this supplement affects fat levels in the blood, blood sugar control, inflammation, and thinking skills. The study plans to include 210 participants. Participants will take either the dietary supplement or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks the same, for 12 weeks.
